_what: D230 (11): HOW MANY DECISIONS the residency belief's errors would CHANGE, in the committed final-ladder rung-3 and rung-4 live cells. MEASURE ONLY, NO FIX. The belief's error itself is NOT re-derived here: it is carried from d211_signal_a_validated.json (committed 5544a818), which measured the belief under-predicting local GPU prefix about 1.8x overall and over-claiming on 2,466 of 2,661 (92.7 percent) named-session requests. This row converts that token-level error into a DECISION COUNT, per decision kind, per cell.
_register: EVERY count below is an UPPER BOUND on the number of decisions that would change, not a point estimate, except where the row says EXACT. Three separate reasons, stated so neither is mistaken for the other: (1) `cached_tokens` is local-GPU-prefix PLUS external-host-transfer, inseparable per request (d211_signal_a_validated.json), so it is an UPPER BOUND on the local prefix and never a ground truth for it; (2) where a predicate's other inputs are not logged per decision, the flip count is bounded by the population that reached that predicate rather than computed on it; (3) the belief and the corrected value both appear on BOTH sides of the fits predicate (`u_rebuild <= free_kv`), so the two effects partly cancel and only the bound survives without the joint distribution. Where a kind is reported ZERO BY CONSTRUCTION that is NOT a measured zero and is labelled as such (CLAUDE.md Rule 2).

how_the_local_versus_host_inseparability._the_caveat: `cached_tokens` is the sum of local GPU prefix hits and external host KV transfer and the engine does not separate them per request. In the cell D211 measured the aggregate split was 46,921,424 local against 2,486,608 external, 95 percent local, but an aggregate share does not license a per-request split.
how_the_local_versus_host_inseparability.for_the_free_kv_bound_kind_the_caveat_IS: The quantity the free-KV read site estimates is an OCCUPANCY (tokens resident in the GPU KV pool at an instant), not a per-request flow. The engine publishes its own GPU KV occupancy gauge, `vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc`, and it IS recorded in every one of the 13 cells in `host_counters_d211.log`. That gauge is purely local by definition and is in the SAME REGISTER as `occ_belief`, so the correction for this kind uses the gauge and never touches `cached_tokens`. The 1.8x flow ratio is NOT applied to an occupancy anywhere in this row; doing so would have been a register error.
how_the_local_versus_host_inseparability.for_the_deferral_and_admission_kinds_the: Those two read sites consume `last_telemetry_cached_tokens`, which IS the inseparable quantity. They already combine it with the belief as `max(built_tokens, telemetry)`, so the correction is a no-op wherever telemetry already won. Treating telemetry as an UPPER BOUND means the true LOCAL prefix may be smaller, so `built > local_truth` on MORE decisions than `built > telemetry`: the belief-set counts reported for those kinds are therefore LOWER bounds on the belief-set population, and the flip counts remain upper bounds because every candidate was recomputed or bounded against its own gate.
how_the_local_versus_host_inseparability.what_is_NOT_claimed: No per-request local/host split is asserted. No decision count is claimed as a census. The 1.8x and the 92.7 percent are cited, not re-measured.

free_kv_bound.the_correction_used_and_why_it_is_the_ri: `vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc` from `host_counters_d211.log`, present in all 13 cells with 117 to 118 samples and 70 to 95 distinct values each, times `header.gpu_kv_tokens`. Occupancy against occupancy; `cached_tokens` is not used for this kind.
free_kv_bound.the_direction_of_the_error_AT_THIS_READ_: On the one rung-4 cell that records the belief per decision (the rerun), the belief's GPU occupancy has median 34,276 and max 48,975 tokens while the engine's own gauge has median 13,291 and max 43,306 on a 62,944-token pool. The belief OVERSTATES resident GPU tokens by about 2.6x at the median here. That makes `free_kv` TOO SMALL, i.e. the gate is PESSIMISTIC, so correcting it makes `fits` MORE often True, not less. The 1.8x under-prediction D211 reports is a per-request FLOW over all 379 sessions including the 357 the belief never names; it does not transfer to this occupancy, and the two directions living in different strata is exactly what D230 (11) asked to be carried rather than collapsed.

decisions_that_would_change.register: UPPER BOUND, and the False-to-True half of it is EXACT
decisions_that_would_change.method: Two directions, bounded separately. FALSE-TO-TRUE: a decision can only gain `fits` if it does not have it, so this half is bounded EXACTLY by the committed count of decisions that reached GATE 3 and did not fit. TRUE-TO-FALSE: needs `u_rebuild > pool - occ_engine` at that instant, so a NECESSARY condition is that the engine gauge leaves less room than the largest rebuild the cell ever had, `kv_usage_perc > 1 - pd_u_max/pool`. That is counted over every engine sample in the cell.
decisions_that_would_change.pooled_1x: <= 9 of 1,453 rung-4 protect-and-defer decisions, 0.62 percent, and 0 at seed 6 exactly
decisions_that_would_change.spread_across_cells: 0, <= 1, <= 2, <= 2, <= 4 (per CLAUDE.md consistency check 3, reported per cell and not only pooled)
decisions_that_would_change.what_the_flips_would_DO: The <= 9 are not neutral: at seeds 4, 4_rerun and 7 they are exactly the decisions that currently FAIL to fit and therefore proceed to the victim and harm computation, and they are the arm's ONLY harm evaluations in those cells (`pd_harm_n` = 3 and `pd_harm_over_bar` = 3 on the rerun). Correcting the belief would turn them into `rebuild_fits_without_evicting` and return BASE, removing the compound's entire firing population on those cells. So the fix would make protect-and-defer fire LESS, not more.
decisions_that_would_change.the_opposing_term_declared: Correcting the belief DOWNWARD also INCREASES `u_rebuild` (`target_tokens - built`), which pushes `fits` the other way. The True-to-False bound above uses the committed `pd_u_max` as the stand-in for the corrected u, which understates it; that is why that half is a bound and not a count, and why the necessary-condition test was run over every engine sample rather than only the extremes.

results_consistency_check.3_distribution_sanity: Every per-cell quantity is reported with its spread and never only pooled. Three constants were examined. (a) `belief.gpu_tokens_by_session` empty on 8 of 13 cells: chased to the cell git_commit and confirmed not a join fault, see `the_constant_chased_to_source`. (b) `pd_kv_bound_by_engine_metric` = 0 in all 5 rung-4 cells: chased, and it is the correct and consistent zero that CONTRACT.md already records, caused by `gpu_kv_fraction` reaching the arm as 0.0; it is a real absence of the engine read, and this row treats it as the premise of the measurement rather than as a result. (c) touch price exactly 3.0000 milli GPU-s per touch in all 13 cells and all 174 to 3,023 touches: chased to the ruled D174 (1) constant charge `per_uncached * 15`, which is a constant BY DESIGN, and that is precisely why the touch kind is zero by construction. The engine gauge is NOT a constant: 70 to 95 distinct values over 117 to 118 samples per cell.
results_consistency_check.3b_stratum_beside_the_mean: The free-KV error is reported as a MEDIAN RATIO (belief 34,276 against engine 13,291) AND as the population it can act on (7 non-fitting decisions of 1,453), because a 2.6x occupancy error averaged over 1,453 decisions reads as large while the decisions it can move number single digits. Both are given so neither reading stands alone. Likewise the deferral error is given as the belief-set population (23 to 42 per cell) AND as the gate each of those 35 sat at on the one resolvable cell (4 pre-gate, 16 no-slack, 3 deferring, 12 margin), because the population alone would imply up to 42 flips where the resolved count is 0.

SAME NAME, DIFFERENT DEFINITION, inside the same arm, and it is reported here rather than reconciled because this task forbids a fix: the D186/r1 telemetry correction was applied to the deferral and admission paths and NOT to the protect-and-defer path. That asymmetry is the single most actionable finding in this row.

results_consistency_check.5_claim_linkage: Bears on D166 and on FORMULATION's residency-belief claim that the coordinator's bookkeeping, corrected by engine telemetry, is an adequate stand-in for engine residency (D44, D47, D150: residency cannot be commanded). The result WEAKENS the strong form of that claim (the belief is off by about 2.6x in occupancy at the one site where telemetry was never wired in) and SUPPORTS the operational form (the error changes at most 9 of 1,453 decisions of the one kind it can reach, and 0 of every other kind). Nothing here is scoped out by FORMULATION's Scoping section: no cross-tier KV transfer is measured, and the engine gauge used is a local GPU occupancy.

proxy_1_vllm_kv_cache_usage_perc_as_the_.what_it_actually_measures: the engine's own fraction of its GPU KV block pool in use, over ALL traffic
proxy_1_vllm_kv_cache_usage_perc_as_the_.valid_for_the_claim: YES for the free-KV read site, and BETTER than cached_tokens, because it is the same register (instantaneous occupancy) and is local by definition. It is in fact the quantity the arm WANTED at arms_v6cf.py:339 and did not get. One declared imperfection, which runs AGAINST this row's bound and is therefore conservative: the gauge counts alert-episode contexts and every other tenant, which `occ_belief` does NOT count (arms_v6cf.py:330-333 says so itself). So the gauge is an upper bound on the recall sessions' own occupancy, which makes `free_kv_engine` a LOWER bound and the True-to-False flip bound a genuine upper bound.
proxy_1_vllm_kv_cache_usage_perc_as_the_.clock_join: The engine samples carry unix time and the decision log is run-relative with no unix anchor anywhere (d211_signal_a_validated.json verified 0 epoch-valued lines in every run-relative log). This row therefore uses NO per-epoch clock join: every free-KV number is derived from whole-cell extrema and sample counts, which are anchor-free. That is deliberate, and it is why the True-to-False half is a bound over all 118 samples rather than a count at matched epochs.

proxy_2_last_telemetry_cached_tokens_as_.what_it_actually_measures: the engine's `cached_tokens` on this session's last completed request, which is local GPU prefix hits PLUS external host transfer, inseparable
proxy_2_last_telemetry_cached_tokens_as_.valid_for_the_claim: QUESTIONABLE, and so it is used only for a BOUND and never for a headline. It is an UPPER bound on the local prefix, so `built > telemetry` identifies FEWER belief-set decisions than `built > local_truth` would: the 23 to 42 counts are lower bounds on that population. It is also never reset on eviction (the e9569009 guard, coordinator.py:1410-1413), which is why the code trusts it only while the session is not believed COLD. The deferral conclusion does not rest on it: the 3 deferring decisions were recomputed against MIN_DEFERRAL_S with margins of 0.11 to 0.70 s to spare, and the 12 margin decisions have negative `net` on 11 of 12, both of which hold for any correction in the direction telemetry indicates.
proxy_2_last_telemetry_cached_tokens_as_.affected_analysis_marked: the deferral and admission flip POPULATIONS are marked as lower bounds; the deferral flip COUNT of 0-to-1 is EXACT on the one resolvable cell

alternative_explanation: The headline, that a belief fix would move at most 9 of 1,453 protect-and-defer decisions and 0 of every other kind, could also be produced by (a) the belief error genuinely being almost unactionable at these read sites [the claimed mechanism], or (b) the gates simply being unexercised in these cells for reasons unrelated to the belief, so that nothing could move them. WHAT DISTINGUISHES THEM, per kind: for the FREE-KV kind (b) is refuted, because GATE 3 is exercised both ways (1,253 fits against 7 non-fits), `free_kv` varies over 13,969 to 62,944 rather than being constant, and the belief bound it on 1,453 of 1,453, so the mechanism is live and the smallness of the flip count is a fact about the belief error's direction, not about reachability. For the DEFERRAL kind (b) is also refuted: 22 to 37 deferrals fired per cell. For the ADMISSION and TOUCH kinds (b) IS the explanation and this row says so rather than claiming (a): the budget refused nothing at any price and touch refused nothing at all, so those zeros are UNEXERCISED, not evidence that the belief error is harmless there. Anyone reading the pooled zero as (a) across all five kinds would be wrong on two of them.

ANSWER_is_a_belief_fix_worth_building_be.one_line: NO for a belief-accuracy fix, and the number that drives it is 9 of 1,453: correcting the residency belief changes at most 9 of the 1,453 rung-4 protect-and-defer decisions, 0.62 percent, and 0 decisions of all four other kinds, with three of those four zero BY CONSTRUCTION.
ANSWER_is_a_belief_fix_worth_building_be.the_cheap_thing_that_IS_worth_doing_inst: A one-line asymmetry, not a belief model. `arms_v6cf.py:465-466` and `:497-498` compute `u_rebuild` from `built_tokens` ALONE while `arms_v6cfr3.py:186` and `coordinator.py:1428-1431` already use `max(built_tokens, last_telemetry_cached_tokens)` for the same physical quantity. The D186/r1 correction was applied to two of the three sites and not the third. Applying it at the free-KV site is the same three lines already committed twice, and it is the only place in the five kinds where the belief reaches a decision with NO engine term at all.
ANSWER_is_a_belief_fix_worth_building_be.the_number_that_would_change_the_answer: If the metrics scrape were ON, `obs.cloud.gpu_kv_fraction` would carry the engine gauge and `max(occ_metric, occ_belief)` would take the engine value wherever it is larger, which the gauge says is 1 of 118 samples per cell. So even landing the scrape, which is already built (D216 (2), D222 (1) g, E3 by D227), changes the free-KV bound by at most the same single-digit count. The belief's error is not what is limiting these cells.
ANSWER_is_a_belief_fix_worth_building_be.what_this_does_NOT_say: It does not say the belief is accurate. It is off by about 2.6x in GPU occupancy at the one read site where no engine term corrects it. It says the decisions in the committed cells are not close enough to their thresholds for that error to move them, which is a fact about THESE cells and could change in a regime where the KV pool is the binding resource. The rung-4 0.25x-memory line (d210_rung4_kv025, d216_final_kv025) is where that regime lives, and this row does not measure it.
